en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a brick Catholic church with a steep tiled roof and tall spire behind a brick wall and iron gates. Trees partially obscure the church façade. Two children stand on the street in the foreground. In the distance to the right, another tower rises above nearby buildings. Printed German captions at the top read the town name and indicate that the building is a Catholic church.
